svg.aria-label: F169.7 the sequence drawn for a phone: the interface design
svg.title: F169.7 the sequence drawn for a phone: the interface design

g.text: F169.7 the sequence drawn for a phone: the interface design

text.tspan: A second layout and a second drawing for the data a sequence already is. The layout hands back placed records, as the wide one does, and the drawing reuses the wide drawing's beam, dashes, frames and key. Each new type is marked with its step.
